intent_proportional_share.quote: 3. Contradicts documented design - The NatSpec promises rewards "allocated pro rata to users' shares of the total bonded balance." A user bonded for an entire epoch receiving 0% of their share violates this guarantee.

This ensures users who were bonded during the epoch receive their fair share of rewards proportional to their bonded balance, rather than getting zero due to the snapshot timing coinciding with exact lock expiry.

intent_capture_bonded_balance.quote: Instead of snapshotting balance at the exact `epochTimestampEnd` (where the linear decay has already zeroed out), the reward calculation should detect when a user's lock expires within the epoch and sample their balance at `locked.end - 1`(the last second they were bonded).
This captures the user's non-zero balance at the moment just before expiry and gives them proportional credit for the time they were bonded during that epoch.

This ensures users who were bonded during the epoch receive their fair share of rewards proportional to their bonded balance, rather than getting zero due to the snapshot timing coinciding with exact lock expiry.
